machine_details.machine_type: High Temperature High Pressure Rope Dyeing Machine

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: Cotton knits, Polyester knits & wovens, Polyamide, Viscose, T/C Blends
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Disperse Dyes, Acid Dyes, Direct Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Salt, Soda Ash, Caustic Soda, Hydros, Acetic Acid, Leveling Agents
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Scouring, Bleaching, Exhaust Dyeing, Soaping, Reduction Clearing, Softening

machine_constraints.maximum_load: 300 kg (Overloading >320 kg causes turn time >120s and severe rope marks)
machine_constraints.minimum_load: 150 kg (Underloading <120 kg alters liquor ratio and causes liquor foaming)
machine_constraints.temperature_restrictions: Do not exceed 135°C for elastomeric Lycra blends to avoid heat damage
machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Main safety valve trips at 4.2 bar
machine_constraints.chemical_restrictions: Strictly prohibit Sodium Hypochlorite or free Chlorine (corrodes 316L stainless steel)
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Not suitable for delicate silk satins or ultra-high tension sensitive wovens

performance.water_consumption: 35 to 50 Liters per kg of fabric processed (total process water)
performance.steam_consumption: 2.8 to 3.5 kg steam per kg of fabric
performance.power_consumption: 18.5 kW main pump motor + 5.5 kW winch reel motor

sensors.pressure_sensor: Piezo-resistive Vessel Pressure Transmitter (0 to 6 bar)
sensors.ph_sensor: In-line Industrial Gel-filled Glass Electrode pH Sensor (pH 0-14)
sensors.level_sensor: Differential Pressure Hydrostatic Level Transmitter (0-100% tank volume)

operating_parameters.recommended_temperature: 60°C for Reactive Dyeing | 130°C for Disperse Dyeing
operating_parameters.recommended_speed: 250 to 350 m/min winch reel speed (Turn time 50 to 75 seconds)

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect main pump shaft seal, clean lint filter basket, check pneumatic door seal
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect heat exchanger steam traps, calibrate pH electrode, check reel belt tension
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate PT100 temp sensors, inspect safety burst disc, check main valve actuators
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Quarterly calibration of PT100 sensors and pressure transmitters with certified calibrator

failure_information.common_faults: Rope entanglement/tangle, high differential pressure across filter, steam trap waterlog
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Turn time > 120s, Temp deviation > ±2°C, Vessel pressure > 3.8 bar, Door safety open
failure_information.failure_causes: Fabric knot formation, clogged filter screen, steam supply pressure drop < 5 bar
failure_information.troubleshooting: Reverse winch reel manually; flush filter basket; verify boiler steam pressure

safety.safety_limits: Max temp 140°C, Max pressure 4.0 bar, Door opening temp limit < 80°C
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Vessel overpressure > 4.1 bar, main circulation pump dry-run, power outage
safety.ppe_requirements: Heat-resistant gloves, safety goggles, steel-toe boots, ear protection

machine_operating_rules: IF fabric_type == 'Polyester' THEN max_temperature = 130°C AND min_pressure = 2.8 bar
IF fabric_type == 'Cotton' THEN max_temperature = 98°C AND pressure = 0.0 bar
IF fabric_gsm < 150 THEN max_nozzle_pressure = 0.5 bar (prevent pilling)
interlock_conditions: Pneumatic door lock MUST remain ENGAGED while Vessel_Temperature > 80°C OR Vessel_Pressure > 0.2 bar
Heating valve MUST CLOSE if Main_Pump_Flow < 200 L/min (dry run prevention)
decision_rules: REJECT recipe IF liquor_ratio < 1:5 OR liquor_ratio > 1:10
FLAG WARNING IF heating_rate > 1.5°C/min between 90°C and 130°C on Polyester
best_operating_practices: Perform hot drain at 80°C after disperse dyeing to keep oligomers in emulsion state
Dose alkali exponentially over 30 min for reactive dyes to prevent strike unlevelness
